title: Character Stream Flush Drill
statement: Practice a line-based character stream contract locally. This is a prerequisite drill for TCP character stream exercises and does not connect to a real exam server.
processing_requirement: Read one input line, transform it to uppercase, write the transformed line, then flush the writer.
hints: A buffered writer may keep data in memory until flush is called.
explanation: This pilot is intentionally content-only. It prepares for observed TCP character stream failures without claiming to be an exam problem.
